item.title: Oakfield-Alabama students tackle early literacy with reading awareness night
item.description: Tracy Schlagenhauf, Tegan Falk, Landon Pangrazio, Pete Beuler, and Colin Kirkum.Photo by Howard Owens. When Oakfield-Alabama students Tegan Falk and Landon Pangrazio looked at issues facing their community, one problem stood out: too few students were achieving reading proficiency.Their solution? Get parents reading to their kids at home.
